title: Acupuncture Delivery In The Clinical Decision Unit (CDU) For The Management Of Pain, Nausea, And Other Symptoms
official: Acupuncture Delivery In The Clinical Decision Unit (CDU) For The Management Of Pain, Nausea, And Other Symptoms
summary: The overall goal of this research is to improve the management of distressing symptoms, specifically nausea and pain, in cancer patients within the acute care setting of the CDU at MD Anderson.
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

In order to be eligible to participate in this study, an individual must meet all of the following criteria:

1. Adult patients (aged ≥18 years)
2. Presenting with a primary complaint of nausea and/or pain
3. ESAS nausea and/or pain score of at least 2
4. Admitted to the CDU for observation and management of nausea and/or pain.

Exclusion Criteria:

An individual who meets any of the following criteria will be excluded from participation in this study:

1. History of a bleeding disorder
2. Coagulation profile with an INR \> 2.0 and/or PTT \> 90 seconds
3. Initiation of anticoagulation for venous thrombosis within the last 24 hours or not yet at a therapeutic dose
4. Evidence of bowel obstruction on imaging
5. Platelet count \< 25,000/uL
6. Absolute Neutrophil Count (ANC) \< 1.0 K/uL
7. Delirium or cognitive impairment in the opinion of the primary CDU physician that limits the ability to follow instructions or provide informed consent.
8. Pregnant patients for whom the treating physician or acupuncturist determines acupuncture is not clinically appropriate.
